the quantum-chemical parameters of the molecules of sydnones (SN) and sydnoniminium (SNI) ions were calculated by the HMO method using four variants of parameters.

the quantum chemical characteristics of sydnoses and sydnoniminnes, calculated using the Hückel model with four parameter sets obtained using the Pariser-Patt-Pople model, are in good agreement with the experimentally determined molecular parameters of these molecules.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the quantum-chemical parameters of sydnone and sydnoniminium ions calculated by the HMO method are in good agreement with the experimental data, but the parameters calculated by the PPP method are in poor agreement with the experimental values.
the Hückel calculations with parameters obtained from the PPP method give the best agreement of the theoretical and experimental characteristics of sydnonyl radicals and sydnones and their imines.
the quantum-chemical method of the Hückel type is suitable for calculating the molecular parameters of the sydnones and the sydnonimine molecules.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the calculated characteristics of the sydnone and sydnonimin molecules are in qualitative agreement with the experimentally determined molecular parameters.

the quantum-chemical method can be used to calculate the molecular characteristics of sydnons and sydnonimin, and the calculated characteristics can be compared with the experimentally measured values.
